```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = TRUE, message = TRUE)
```

# Overview

This script renders a **gganatogram anatomogram** for a given gene cluster module.

It reads a CSV of organ-level phenotype burden values (`module_id`, `organ`, `value`),
filters to a selected module, joins onto the full human male anatomy background,
and visualizes the result as a color-mapped body figure.

Optional organ labels are placed on the top-K organs by phenotype burden using
centroid coordinates from `gganatogram`.

The figure is exported as PDF, PNG, and TIFF.

## Context

This script is part of a broader IRD multi-omics pipeline. The `value` column
represents the **percentage of genes in the module** associated with phenotypes
mapped to each organ via the Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO).

This enables communication of complex gene-phenotype data to clinical audiences
in a single, interpretable anatomical figure.

## Inputs
- `INPUT_FILE`: CSV with columns `module_id`, `organ`, `value` (and optional `organ_label`)
- `MODULE_ID`: integer, the cluster to visualize

## Outputs
Files written to `../outputs/` with timestamped names:
- `module_<ID>_<timestamp>.pdf` (vector, for publication)
- `module_<ID>_<timestamp>.png` (quick preview)
- `module_<ID>_<timestamp>.tiff` (high-resolution print)

---

# User Configuration

```{r user-config}
# =============================================================================
# EDIT THESE PARAMETERS
# =============================================================================

# Module to plot (single integer, must exist in INPUT_FILE)
MODULE_ID <- 1

# Input file name (relative to the data/ folder, one level up from scripts/)
INPUT_FILE <- "gganatogram_organs_input_DEMO.csv"

# Plot title (NULL = auto-generated)
PLOT_TITLE <- NULL

# Export dimensions
EXPORT_WIDTH <- 8
EXPORT_HEIGHT <- 6
EXPORT_DPI <- 600

# Label settings
SHOW_LABELS <- TRUE
LABEL_TOP_K <- 10
LABEL_SIZE <- 3.2
LABEL_COLOR <- "#494949"
LABEL_PRETTIFY <- TRUE
```

# Setup

```{r paths}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Path setup — works both when Knitting and running chunks interactively
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# When Knitting, knitr knows the current file path:
if (!is.null(knitr::current_input())) {
    script_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input()))
} else {
    # Running interactively in RStudio: set the path to your scripts/ folder
    # CHANGE THIS if you move the project:
    script_dir <- dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path)
}

project_dir <- dirname(script_dir) # one level up from scripts/
input_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "data")
output_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "outputs")

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M")

cat("Project root:", project_dir, "\n")

```

```{r packages}
# Install gganatogram if needed
if (!requireNamespace("gganatogram", quietly = TRUE)) {
    if (!requireNamespace("devtools", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("devtools")
    devtools::install_github("jespermaag/gganatogram")
}
if (!requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("ggrepel")

library(gganatogram)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(scales)
```

---

# Load and Validate Data

```{r load-data}
input_path <- file.path(input_dir, INPUT_FILE)
data <- read_csv(input_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Filter to selected module
module_data <- data %>%
    filter(module_id == MODULE_ID) %>%
    select(any_of(c("organ", "value", "organ_label")))

if (nrow(module_data) == 0) {
    stop(paste(
        "No data found for module", MODULE_ID,
        "- check that MODULE_ID exists in", INPUT_FILE
    ))
}

cat("Module", MODULE_ID, ":", nrow(module_data), "organs loaded\n")
print(module_data)
```

```{r validate-organs}
# Validate against gganatogram's known organ list
valid_organs <- unique(gganatogram::hgMale_key$organ)
invalid <- setdiff(module_data$organ, valid_organs)

if (length(invalid) > 0) {
    warning(paste("Removed invalid organs:", paste(invalid, collapse = ", ")))
    module_data <- module_data %>% filter(organ %in% valid_organs)
}
```

---

# Build Plot Data

```{r prepare-plot-data}
# Join module values onto the FULL anatomy background (all organs)
# Organs not in the module receive value = 0 (grey)
plot_df <- hgMale_key %>%
    distinct(organ) %>%
    left_join(module_data %>% select(organ, value), by = "organ") %>%
    mutate(value = ifelse(is.na(value), 0, value))

cat("Total organs in anatomy:", nrow(plot_df), "\n")
cat("Organs with values > 0:", sum(plot_df$value > 0), "\n")
```

---

# Create Anatomogram

```{r create-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
if (is.null(PLOT_TITLE)) {
    PLOT_TITLE <- paste0(
        "Anatomical distribution of phenotype-based\norgan enrichment in gene cluster ", MODULE_ID
    )
}

p <- gganatogram(
    data        = plot_df,
    organism    = "human",
    sex         = "male",
    fill        = "value",
    outline     = TRUE,
    fillOutline = "#bdbaba"
) +
    theme_void() +
    coord_fixed() +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
        colours = c("grey95", "#ffe600b4", "#FFA500", "#FF4500", "#8B0000"),
        values = scales::rescale(c(0, 25, 50, 85, 100)),
        limits = c(0, 100),
        breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
        name = "Genes with organ-\nassociated phenotypes (%)",
        na.value = "grey95",
        guide = guide_colorbar(
            barwidth = 1,
            barheight = 10,
            title.position = "top",
            title.hjust = 0.5,
            frame.colour = "#919191",
            frame.linewidth = 0.1
        )
    ) +
    theme(
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold", color = "#494949"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, color = "#494949"),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 6, color = "#494949", hjust = 0, face = "italic"),
        plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
    ) +
    labs(
        title    = PLOT_TITLE,
        subtitle = "Color intensity represents the percentage of genes associated with each organ based on HPO annotations.",
        caption  = "Figure generated using gganatogram (Maag, 2018).\nColor scale: % of cluster genes (0–100%) with organ-specific HPO phenotypes."
    )

print(p)
```

---

# Add Organ Labels

```{r add-labels}
if (SHOW_LABELS) {
    anatomy_list <- gganatogram::hgMale_list

    # Extract centroid coordinates for each organ in the module
    coords_list <- list()
    for (organ_name in module_data$organ) {
        if (!organ_name %in% names(anatomy_list)) next
        organ_data <- anatomy_list[[organ_name]]
        if (is.data.frame(organ_data) && all(c("x", "y") %in% colnames(organ_data))) {
            coords_list[[organ_name]] <- data.frame(
                organ = organ_name,
                x = organ_data$x,
                y = organ_data$y
            )
        }
    }

    if (length(coords_list) > 0) {
        coords_df <- bind_rows(coords_list) %>%
            filter(!is.na(x), !is.na(y)) %>%
            mutate(y = -y) # invert Y to match plot orientation

        centroids <- coords_df %>%
            group_by(organ) %>%
            summarise(x = mean(x), y = mean(y), .groups = "drop") %>%
            inner_join(module_data %>% select(organ, value), by = "organ") %>%
            arrange(desc(value)) %>%
            slice_head(n = LABEL_TOP_K)

        # Use organ_label column if available for cleaner labels
        if ("organ_label" %in% colnames(module_data)) {
            centroids <- centroids %>%
                left_join(module_data %>% select(organ, organ_label) %>% distinct(), by = "organ") %>%
                mutate(label = ifelse(
                    !is.na(organ_label) & organ_label != "",
                    paste0(organ_label, " (", round(value), "%)"),
                    paste0(organ, " (", round(value), "%)")
                ))
        } else {
            centroids <- centroids %>%
                mutate(label = paste0(organ, " (", round(value), "%)"))
        }

        if (LABEL_PRETTIFY) {
            centroids <- centroids %>% mutate(label = gsub("_", " ", label))
        }

        centroids <- centroids %>% filter(!is.na(x), !is.na(y))

        if (nrow(centroids) > 0) {
            body_center_x <- mean(centroids$x)
            centroids <- centroids %>%
                mutate(nudge_x = ifelse(x < body_center_x, -80, 99), nudge_y = 0)

            p <- p + geom_text_repel(
                data = centroids,
                aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
                nudge_x = centroids$nudge_x,
                nudge_y = centroids$nudge_y,
                size = LABEL_SIZE,
                color = LABEL_COLOR,
                fontface = "bold",
                direction = "y",
                force = 2,
                force_pull = 0,
                box.padding = 0.5,
                point.padding = 0.5,
                min.segment.length = 0,
                segment.color = "#7f7f7fc4",
                segment.size = 0.4,
                segment.alpha = 0.6,
                max.overlaps = 20,
                inherit.aes = FALSE,
                seed = 42
            )
        }
    }
}

print(p)
```

---

# Export

```{r export}
base_name <- paste0("module_", MODULE_ID, "_", timestamp)

pdf_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(base_name, ".pdf"))
png_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(base_name, ".png"))
tiff_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(base_name, ".tiff"))

ggsave(pdf_path, p, width = EXPORT_WIDTH, height = EXPORT_HEIGHT, device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave(png_path, p, width = EXPORT_WIDTH, height = EXPORT_HEIGHT, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(tiff_path, p,
    width = EXPORT_WIDTH, height = EXPORT_HEIGHT,
    dpi = EXPORT_DPI, device = "tiff", compression = "lzw", bg = "white"
)

cat("Exported:\n")
cat(" PDF: ", pdf_path, "\n")
cat(" PNG: ", png_path, "\n")
cat(" TIFF:", tiff_path, "\n")
```
